missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Организация' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine, and 'детям' is the dative beneficiary of 'помогает'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Организацию' is the accusative direct object of 'создали'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Организации' is the genitive marking which organization he heads. 'Крупной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Организации' is the dative governed by 'помогаю'. 'Местной' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Организации' is the prepositional form after 'об', the topic of discussion. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Организацией' is the instrumental governed by 'руководит'. 'Большой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Организации' is the prepositional form after 'в', marking the workplace. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Организаций' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Полезных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в городе' gives the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Организации' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'вместе' is the adverb.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Организации' is the genitive after 'без', marking absence. 'Сильной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
